title: Sweet puppy looking for shelter
description: Found this adorable little puppy wandering near Carter Road. He looks a bit lost, hungry, and has very sad eyes, but he is extremely gentle and friendly. Needs a warm foster home and some food.
locationName: Carter Road Promenade, Bandra West, Mumbai

title: Injured dog hiding beside a tea stall
description: A nervous street dog with a visible limp is hiding beside a tea stall and avoiding movement. Locals say he has not eaten since morning.

title: Stray kitten with injured tail
description: Found a small kitten with a bloodied tail near the Lokhandwala market dumpsters. Seems to be in pain but reachable.

title: Tiny kitten shivering in the cold
description: This sweet, tiny calico kitten was found crying next to a car wheel, shivering in the cold wind. She is very small and needs a warm, safe place to stay.
